main.description: A named, public stretch of route for one sport group, which consenting athletes' activities are matched against (app.activitytracker.feed.getActivitySegments). Public: stored only in its creator's repo, never in a space. The AppView computes its length from line, indexes it only when that is 200 m to 50 km, and ignores a copy found in any space.

sport.description: The sport group whose activities can match it. A segment whose group the AppView doesn't know isn't indexed.

line.description: The segment from start to end as an encoded polyline at precision 6 (1e-6 degrees), at least two positions.

source.description: Where the line came from: an athlete's activity, OpenStreetMap or a public agency's dataset.

license.description: The licence of the line's data, as an SPDX identifier such as CC0-1.0 or ODbL-1.0.

derivedFrom.description: The activity the line was traced from, if any.
